'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a researcher located at a Roya camp in the Roya Frostlands.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''Joonas''' Look at all this beautiful [[Meteoric Iron]]!
:;'''Yangquan''' I'll take the whole lot!

==Dialogue==
:'''Yangquan:''' Meteoric Iron... here? And such fine quality.
:'''Joonas:''' From the edge of a Void Storm I dug it. A risk, but look! Beautiful, no?
:'''Yangquan:''' I'll take the whole lot!
:'''Joonas:''' Done. Many come to trade, but rocks that make your eyes shine? You're the first. You aim to research it?
:'''Yangquan:''' Its structure is dense. Exceptionally hard. Makes for an excellent forging material. But I'm interested in its thermal conductivity.
:'''Joonas:''' Ah! Knives and pots we make from it. Cuts the cooking time clean in half.
:'''Yangquan:''' Do you? Then you must know the legend that a full set of Meteoric Iron cookware can spark a... "legendary culinary chain reaction."
:'''Joonas:''' Such a thing? Never heard it. But if you forge a set, you must let me see!
:'''Yangquan:''' Of course, it would also require legendary cooking skills. Now, where could I find such a person?
:'''Yangquan:''' Um... Hold on. I find myself short on funds...
{{Dialogue End}}
